findings.claim: AksharDrishti official page is a client-rendered SPA; static fetch returns only Timeline. Evaluation/Eligibility/Contact tabs and full problem statement need a rendered browser (Playwright). Re-verification must render, not fetch.

Machine-checked absence: zero occurrences on the rendered page (4 tabs + modal) of CER, WER, metric, substitution, deletion, insertion, edit distance, seconds, latency, score, weight, percentage, third-party, dataset, test set, license. No metric published.

Evaluation Process = 6 qualitative parameters, 2 columns, no weights: Approach Towards Problem Solving; Business Use Case; Solution Technical Feasibility; Product Roadmap; Team Ability & Culture; Addressable Market (Channel, Deployment Cost, Customization/Enhancement Cost per person per month, Resource Rate for 4 years).

Only evaluation target named: 'Establishing Standardized Evaluation Pipelines or accuracy, layout detection, and multilingual text handling.' Three dimensions, no metric/formula/threshold/weighting/CER-vs-WER rule.

Rubric is product/business weighted (innovation, business case, feasibility, roadmap, team, addressable market incl. deployment cost) not accuracy-weighted. Bottom line: optimise weak cells and the pitch, report CER/CI/WER on own labelled terms.

CONFLATION ALERT: 'Word Level Accuracy > 95%' and 'Low latency < 1 sec/page' are from the 2023 Bhashini Grand Innovation Challenge (problem 02), NOT AksharDrishti 2026. Never cite as AksharDrishti rubric; if used, label 2023.

JSON + searchable PDF appear only as a Key Focus Area (Post-OCR Pipeline: layout-preserving output formats JSON, searchable PDF; transliteration + language detection; context-based correction), not as a submission requirement. Files vs hosted API vs repo vs demo unpublished.

Deliverable classes inferred from timeline row names: ideas, initial prototype (Stage 2), final prototype (Stage 3); format of each unpublished. 2023 challenge was Stage1 registration+PPT, Stage2 HW shipment+prototype, Stage3 in-person jury (not transferable).
No official AksharDrishti deadline: timeline 12 rows, only 2 dated (launch 12/02/2026; Pitch Screening Session 23/07/2026), 10 TBD incl. all submission/qualifier/winner dates. UAT mirror identical.

'Qualifiers close 30/09' belongs to the Rajasthan Language Model Training Hackathon (Stage 2&3 qualifier declaration 30/09/2026; Stage 4 train/optimise 05/10; Stage 4 results 14/10; Stage 5 testing 16/10; Stage 5 results 22/10; prize Rs 90 lakhs). Dies as AksharDrishti rule.

VYOMA only: 'need not be limited to Bhashini APIs and models, but should feature them'.

Official domain statement: government/legal/citizen-service Indian-language documents with complex layouts, low-resolution scans, handwritten content, multilingual text. Six Key Focus Areas: complex layouts (multi-column, nested tables, forms, govt templates); low-quality scans (blur, fading, folds, stamps, seals, skew, denoise); HTR; multilingual/code-mixed; model adaptation; post-OCR pipeline.

Official handwriting text: 'Full-page handwritten or cursive text', 'Mixed typed and handwritten documents', 'Regional handwriting styles in Indic scripts'. Page-level/mixed handwriting is named, not only single-word HW; relevant to plan v4 word-only test assumption.
Low-quality scan focus (blur, fading, folds, stamps, seals, skew/rotation, denoising, contrast enhancement) is explicitly named: supports R4 OldScan restoration work.

findings.claim: Surya code 0.22.1 is Apache-2.0 but weights are Modified AI Pubs OpenRAIL-M v0.1: Attachment A 2(a) >$5M revenue, 2(b) >$5M funding (research/personal exempt), 2(c) competing product/service 'for any purpose' with NO threshold or research carve-out. Commercial Indic OCR product trips 2(c) even under $5M. Audit missed 2(c). NOT CLEARED for commercial product.

Surya RAIL-M s8 share-alike extends to Output and derivatives of Output, so fine-tuning/training on surya transcriptions (pseudo-labels) inherits $5M cap and 2(c); s4(a) requires flowing use restrictions to downstream users; s7 attribution. NOT CLEARED for training-on-surya-outputs (DERIVED reading).

U14 outcome: shipping surya in submission/product under $5M cap is not a live option commercially; permissive per-language fallback is the clean path; a Datalab commercial licence is worth pricing (whether it waives 2(c) unknown; boss decision). Research/benchmark-only use (probe22 eval) is permissive.

Corrections to docs/legal/LICENSE_AUDIT.md: surya package not self-contradicting (two scopes: code vs weights; wheel has 0 weight entries, weights fetched from datalab-to/surya-ocr-2); CRAFT detector 'non-commercial' suspicion REFUTED for code (clovaai/CRAFT-pytorch MIT, NAVER 2019-present).
EasyOCR craft_mlt_25k.pth (83,152,330 B) is a JaidedAI release asset (pre-v1.1.6), not CRAFT-pytorch; weight licence UNKNOWN. Six Indic EasyOCR recognition .pth (215 MB each) ship with no licence.

IndicPhotoOCR script-ID weights are a ViT fine-tune (google/vit-base-patch16-224-in21k, ViTForImageClassification, 12 classes), NOT CLIP; 343,254,736 B safetensors. Release repo anikde/STscriptdetect is MIT (Bhashini Team@IIT Jodhpur 2024) -> CONDITIONAL (base ckpt licence unchecked). 12 classes exclude Ol Chiki and Meetei Mayek (cannot route sat/mni).

IndicPhotoOCR package MIT, BharatSceneTextDataset Apache-2.0; recognition/detection weight repos (STocr, SceneTextDetection) licences still unverified. Plan v4 relies on local IndicPhotoOCR PARSeq checkpoints, so this gap applies to the Handwriting Expert.

Tesseract fallback chain: tesseract_indic 5.5.2, tesseract_bilingual, openbharatocr 0.4.3 Apache-2.0 packages (tessdata upstream unverified); rapidocr 3.9.2, paddleocr 3.7.0, doctr 1.1.0 Apache-2.0 packages (weight chains unverified); anuvaad_tesseract traineddata licence UNKNOWN.

Bodhan IndicOCR (bodhan-ai/indic-ocr, gated) under Indic Open Model License v1.0 (updated 05 Sept 2026): attribution 'Built with [Model] from Bodhan AI / AI4Bharat' needed in UI/top-level docs, NOT in OCR output; s2.4 internal use exempt. CONDITIONAL.

Bodhan binding conditions: s3.1 third-party hosting needs prior written approval + commercial agreement (a hosted judge endpoint is plausibly Hosting; s3.2 carve-out for internal-component use, s3.5 anti-structuring); s4 waiver if open-released same licence within 90 days; s5 derivative carries same licence; s14 >500M MAU or US$250M revenue; Derivative includes model trained substantially on Bodhan Output; contact support@bodhan.ai; Indian law.

Training on Bodhan outputs (pseudo-labels, distillation) makes our model a Derivative inheriting Bodhan licence (attribution, hosting approval, same-licence); plan v4 Page Expert uses Bodhan IndicDocLayout + IndicBlockOCR so this applies.
